# Native swap HTTP fixtures

The six cases in native.json were exported from PropAMM deprecating-router
revision 6fb6483 using export.rs. The exporter runs inside the real
server/tests/native_routing/api.rs test module in a temporary source archive.
It calls the native HTTP quote endpoint against loopback RPC/pricing fixtures;
it does not call production services or modify the PropAMM checkout.

Each case contains the exact request and response, plus the Rust-serialized
message and complete unsigned transaction as hex. The cases cover:

- A single treasury leg with an input above JavaScript's safe integer range.
- A zero-key display-only quote for an unconnected visitor.
- Two treasury legs sharing one authority/signature slot.
- A user-only CLAMM transaction with variable input spend and fixed output.
- Treasury → CLAMM → Treasury in both directions, including two intermediate
  remainders and distinct treasury issuance IDs.

All reserved signatures are zeroed. Accounts and keys come from the server's
synthetic test fixtures. The packets establish wire/serialization compatibility,
not funded execution, wallet signature validity, or production readiness. The
TypeScript tests use fake wallet signatures and pin their clock before the
recorded quote expiry.

## Regenerate

Run from the SDK root. Cargo dependencies must be cached for offline operation.
The test servers need permission to bind localhost; no public network is used.
Use a temporary target directory or an existing writable Cargo build cache.

    fixture_sdk="$PWD"
    fixture_propamm="$HOME/Arch/prop-amm"
    fixture_root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/native-swap-api-fixtures.XXXXXX)
    git -C "$fixture_propamm" archive 6fb6483 | tar -x -C "$fixture_root"
    printf '\ninclude!(r#"%s"#);\n' "$fixture_sdk/tests/fixtures/native-swap/export.rs" >> "$fixture_root/server/tests/native_routing/api.rs"
    NATIVE_SWAP_FIXTURES_OUT="$fixture_root/native.json" cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path "$fixture_root/Cargo.toml" --target-dir "$fixture_root/target" -p prop-amm-server export_native_swap_api_sdk_fixtures -- --nocapture

Copy the generated native.json into this directory. Formatting is immaterial;
the checked-in version stores one case per line to keep large byte arrays
compact. Quote IDs, timestamps, and issuance IDs are generated by the server and
can change between exports. Do not rewrite the native expected hex using SDK
serialization.
